\documentclass[a4paper,10pt,fleqn]{article}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{fuzz}
\begin{document}

\begin{zed}
ZBOOL ::= ztrue | zfalse
\end{zed}

\begin{zed}
SEG ::= segDocs | segFile
\end{zed}

\begin{zed}
PATSEG ::= litSeg \ldata SEG \rdata | wildRestSeg
\end{zed}

\begin{axdef}
maxSegs : \nat
\where
maxSegs = 2
\end{axdef}

\begin{schema}{ENTRY}
isDir, isEI : ZBOOL \\
pattern : \seq PATSEG \\
rootGlob : ZBOOL \\
truncLen : \nat \\
seg1, seg2 : PATSEG
\where
\# pattern \leq maxSegs \\
isEI = ztrue \implies isDir = ztrue \\
\forall i : 1 \upto \# pattern @ pattern(i) = wildRestSeg \implies i = \# pattern \\
rootGlob = (\IF \# pattern = 1 \land pattern(1) = wildRestSeg \THEN ztrue \ELSE zfalse) \\
truncLen = (\IF \# pattern > 0 \land pattern(\# pattern) = wildRestSeg
             \THEN \# pattern - 1 \ELSE \# pattern) \\
truncLen \geq 1 \implies seg1 = pattern(1) \\
truncLen \geq 2 \implies seg2 = pattern(2)
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{Store}
open : 1 \upto 2 \pfun ENTRY
\where
\forall i, j : \dom open | i \neq j @
  \lnot ( \lnot ((open\ i).isEI = ztrue \land (open\ j).isEI = ztrue) \land
    ( ( (open\ i).isDir = (open\ j).isDir \land
        (open\ i).truncLen > 0 \land (open\ j).truncLen > 0 \land
        ( (open\ i).rootGlob = ztrue \lor (open\ j).rootGlob = ztrue
          \lor ( (open\ i).seg1 = (open\ j).seg1 \land
                ( (open\ i).truncLen = 1 \lor (open\ j).truncLen = 1
                  \lor (open\ i).seg2 = (open\ j).seg2 ) ) ) )
      \lor ( (open\ i).isDir = zfalse \land (open\ j).isDir = ztrue \land
        (open\ j).truncLen \leq (open\ i).truncLen \land
        ( (open\ j).truncLen \geq 1 \implies (open\ j).seg1 = (open\ i).seg1 ) \land
        ( (open\ j).truncLen \geq 2 \implies (open\ j).seg2 = (open\ i).seg2 ) )
      \lor ( (open\ j).isDir = zfalse \land (open\ i).isDir = ztrue \land
        (open\ i).truncLen \leq (open\ j).truncLen \land
        ( (open\ i).truncLen \geq 1 \implies (open\ i).seg1 = (open\ j).seg1 ) \land
        ( (open\ i).truncLen \geq 2 \implies (open\ i).seg2 = (open\ j).seg2 ) ) ) )
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{Init}
Store'
\where
open' = \emptyset
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{AdmitMission}
\Delta Store \\
slot? : 1 \upto 2 \\
entry? : ENTRY
\where
slot? \notin \dom open \\
\forall i : \dom open @
  \lnot ( \lnot (entry?.isEI = ztrue \land (open\ i).isEI = ztrue) \land
    ( (entry?.isDir = (open\ i).isDir \land
        entry?.truncLen > 0 \land (open\ i).truncLen > 0 \land
        ( entry?.rootGlob = ztrue \lor (open\ i).rootGlob = ztrue
          \lor ( entry?.seg1 = (open\ i).seg1 \land
                ( entry?.truncLen = 1 \lor (open\ i).truncLen = 1
                  \lor entry?.seg2 = (open\ i).seg2 ) ) ) )
      \lor (entry?.isDir = zfalse \land (open\ i).isDir = ztrue \land
        (open\ i).truncLen \leq entry?.truncLen \land
        ( (open\ i).truncLen \geq 1 \implies (open\ i).seg1 = entry?.seg1 ) \land
        ( (open\ i).truncLen \geq 2 \implies (open\ i).seg2 = entry?.seg2 ) )
      \lor ((open\ i).isDir = zfalse \land entry?.isDir = ztrue \land
        entry?.truncLen \leq (open\ i).truncLen \land
        ( entry?.truncLen \geq 1 \implies entry?.seg1 = (open\ i).seg1 ) \land
        ( entry?.truncLen \geq 2 \implies entry?.seg2 = (open\ i).seg2 ) ) ) ) \\
open' = open \oplus \{ slot? \mapsto entry? \}
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{ReleaseMission}
\Delta Store \\
slot? : 1 \upto 2
\where
slot? \in \dom open \\
open' = \{ slot? \} \ndres open
\end{schema}

\end{document}

tool_input.message:
Verdict: PASS. Mission m-2026-09-20-005, commit baf22d0, round 1 by jms. I verified every contract criterion against the code, not the worker's narrative, and re-ran the tooling myself (fuzz check, ProB model_check on the committed file, a reconstructed errata-composed variant, and two reconstructed decoupled scratch documents). No blocking findings. Mission not closed; no code or spec files touched by me — all work in .tmp/jra-eval-005/.

Per-criterion:

1. DES-076 Abandon gate re-baseline (blockingDelegationCount, DelegateAborted, DisclaimDelegation, AbandonSafety) — PASS. countBlockingDelegations (store.go:1959-1999) skips Verdict==DelegationVerdictAborted unconditionally (1993-1995) and DisclaimedAt!="" (1990-1992), matching the spec's rename and both exclusions exactly. DelegateAborted's Xi Mission self-loop is a sound model: both real call sites (pretooluse_dispatch.go closeDelegationAborted, subagent_start.go closeSkeletonOnHashRefusal) fire before the worker starts and the aborted verdict is excluded independent of BoundVia, so "invisible to every field this spec tracks" is accurate. DisclaimDelegation's status guard (store.go:1542-1547, cited 1542-1547, actual message at 1544) is verbatim; the abstraction from the real three-part per-record eligibility check (delegation.go:707-720) down to a count-level guard is explicitly justified and consistent with the modelling-economy argument already applied elsewhere in the document. AbandonSafety's restatement over the renamed field checks out by direct inspection of the four operations named.

2. DES-072 exclusion argument — PASS. Read Store.Correct (correct.go:187-228) directly: guard refuses status==StatusOpen (line 209, cited 207-210, "corrections apply only to closed missions" — exact string match), the function's only mutation is one appendEventLocked call with EventCorrect (no Mission-schema field touched), and the event log is already outside the Mission schema (Sec 3, state section). All three supporting facts are correct; TerminalIsFinal needs no restatement.

3. Tooling re-run — PASS, with one non-blocking note. fuzz check: 0 errors, confirmed. ProB model_check on the committed file at default setsize=2: 373 states, 989 transitions — exact match to the Tool run table. I reconstructed the errata's "+AbandonFailOpen" composed variant (adding a live Delta-Mission AbandonFailOpen schema to a copy of the committed file) and got 385 states, 1025 transitions, 0 assertion violations — exact match to the documented false-negative row, and the schema-calculus unsatisfiability argument in the errata section is correct Z reasoning, independently re-derived. I reconstructed both decoupled MissionU scratch documents from the prose (they are deliberately not part of the committed namespace, so exact byte reproduction isn't possible): the decoupled Abandon variant reproduced exactly (15 states, 29 transitions, "not certified complete", 0 violations). The decoupled AbandonFailOpen variant reproduced the deadlock with the identical 4-step trace (SETUP_CONSTANTS -> INITIALISATION -> Delegate -> AbandonFailOpen -> deadlock at blockingDelegationCount=1) but at different raw counts (10 states/25 transitions vs. the documented 7/21) — expected variance from reconstructing an uncommitted scratch file from prose rather than source; the substantive claim (this trace deadlocks) is confirmed, not just the number.

4. Currency rule — PASS. Present in Sec 1.3 (Scope) and as one line in docs/development.md's Standards Checklist. `make check` passes clean end to end (golangci-lint, shellcheck, markdownlint 0 issues across 332 files, go test -race all green, validate-content, fuzz gate on all four specs).

5. Traceability refresh — PASS. Baseline updated 9a60b39 -> 244b6c3 in both the header comment and the Traceability table's closing line. I spot-checked considerably more than 6 citations directly against internal/mission/store.go and correct.go: func Close (956), StatusAbandoned-excluded comment (957), close-status error string (964), func Abandon doc comment start (1234) and func start (1290), terminal-state guard (1343, cited 1341-1346), repoRoot guard (1376, cited 1374-1380), result-gate error (1437, cited 1422-1441), func DisclaimDelegation (1516), disclaim status guard (1544, cited 1542-1547), func countBlockingDelegations (1959), aborted/disclaimed exclusions (1990-1995), func Correct (187), guard (209, cited 207-210), doc-comment quote start (163, cited 163-171). Every one matches exactly.

6. Write-set — PASS. `git show baf22d0 --stat` confirms only docs/spec-mission-lifecycle.tex and docs/development.md plus three .punt-labs/ethos/missions/.../*.jsonl audit-seal bookkeeping files, which the contract exempts.

7. AdvanceRound coverage gap disclosure — PASS, and independently confirmed rather than taken on faith. I checked out the actual pre-rebaseline commit (782c646, the original 7-op baseline) and ran model_check on it directly: 373 states, 749 transitions, AdvanceRound never fires — bit-for-bit what the disclosure claims. This is a genuine pre-existing gap, correctly scoped out of this mission (none of Abandon/DelegateAborted/DisclaimDelegation touch AdvanceRound's guard, budgetRounds, or reflected), and correctly disclosed rather than silently carried forward.

8. #517 scope decision — PASS. Recorded in Sec 1.3 as the currency rule's "other branch working correctly": PR #517 widened free-text validation without touching any Status/guard/transition, so no schema amendment was owed. Matches the mission brief's open question about #517 being data hygiene.

9. Commit granularity — one commit for the whole diff. Acceptable: this is a single, atomic PR-equivalent slice (one document re-baseline plus a one-line companion checklist edit), not an accumulation of unrelated concerns, so it satisfies the spirit of "one commit per logical step" even though it is literally one commit.

No round-2 findings. The worker's "not certified complete" framing for the corrected Abandon variant is honest, not evasive — it correctly states a real ProB bounded-search limitation and is contrasted transparently against the buggy variant's positive, reproduced deadlock.
